sentences.text: T2 Trainspotting is a 2017 British comedy drama film , set in and around Edinburgh , Scotland .	Trainspotting	Trainspotting (film)	Edinburgh	Edinburgh	comedy	comedy	drama film	Drama (film and television)

The film is directed by Danny Boyle and written by John Hodge , based on characters created by Irvine Welsh in his novel Trainspotting and its follow-up Porno .	Danny Boyle	Danny Boyle	John Hodge	John Hodge (screenwriter)	Porno	Porno (novel)	Trainspotting	Trainspotting (film)	Irvine Welsh	Irvine Welsh
T2 was released in the United Kingdom on 27 January 2017 and worldwide throughout February and March 2017 .

A sequel to Boyle 's 1996 film , Trainspotting , T2 stars the original ensemble cast , including Ewan McGregor , Ewen Bremner , Jonny Lee Miller , Robert Carlyle , and Kelly Macdonald .
